title: Drug of choice reflex
caption:
Convulsive status epilepticus: a benzodiazepine first (IV lorazepam in hospital; buccal midazolam or rectal diazepam in the community). Levetiracetam, phenytoin or valproate only if 2 benzo doses fail.
